title: UltraAEAddon
description: Addon for AdvancedEnchantments, more placeholders and commands
body:
![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b63553e89be35b5e5d0b23a2ed13c9c286e2e6ff.png)

[![Discord](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5454a09dfcf83072845594e14ce1d662c6aaf564.png)](https://discord.com/invite/qCZwhjM9Tu)

<details>
<summary>Text Transcrip</summary>
This addon adds new placeholders to use with PlaceholderAPI, since the default plugin doesn't include placeholders to retrieve, for example, the item's enchantment level, how many slots are left, how many are used, etc.

```
UltraAEAddon - Information
==========================

Placeholders:
- %ultraae_slots_used%: Current used slots on item
- %ultraae_slots_max%: Total slots available on item
- %ultraae_slots_free%: Remaining free slots on item
- %ultraae_level_<enchant>%: Level of a specific enchantment
- %ultraae_has_<enchant>%: Check if item has an enchantment (Yes/No)
- %ultraae_group_<enchant>%: Get the group name of an enchantment

Commands:
- /ultraae addslot: Adds 1 slot increaser directly to the item in hand (no limits).
- /ultraae addslotincreaser: Adds 1 slot respecting AE's max-increase-of-slots limit.
```


</details>
